entries.title: WIMP Gamma-Ray Line at ~43 GeV from Galaxy Clusters
entries.source: Yi-Zhong Fan et al., Physical Review Letters (2026)
entries.c9_relevance: First compelling WIMP dark matter detection candidate. Sharp 43 GeV gamma-ray line from stacked Virgo, Fornax, Ophiuchus clusters via 15-year Fermi-LAT dataset. Signal difficult to produce astrophysically, precisely matches WIMP annihilation prediction. Not instrumental glitch (galactic center check negative). Signal fluctuated (dipped 2016, climbing). Needs VLAST confirmation. Directly links to A_c non-random structure detection in dark matter halos.

entries.title: Deuterated Silicon Nitride Waveguides for On-Chip Supercontinuum

Coherence >0.81 at moderate power. Enables integrated photonic quantum computing and optical frequency combs on chip.
entries.authors: Yao Wang, Dawn Tan, Luo Xianshu et al.

entries.title: Molecular Ion-Photon Entanglement: Imperceptible Recoil Made Measurable

Potential for quantum-enhanced molecular sensing and single-molecule force detection at quantum limits.
